definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.150) 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division'; §2023:3.145 adds 'paragraph, section' explicitly, which a single paragraph or section already is in 2002, so the set of procedures is the same. This rule's use ('the procedures to be used' in a declarative section) names the same units in 2002; scope and evidence unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.12.1.2, 14.5.12.1.3 and 14.5.12.2 (fatal and non-fatal processing, incompatible data); the 2023 text adds the PERFORM WHEN arm, the SORT/MERGE and I-O status arms and APPLY COMMIT, none writable in 2002. This syntax rule places the USE statement after a section header in a sentence by itself; it matched only on 'declarative'. No dependence; evidence unchanged.
